subject: Renewal: SLA staircase & capacity uptier discussion
body:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.ai>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal planning — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Lukas / Priyom,

We’re coming up on our renewal for Q1 2027 and Greenleaf would like to upgrade the support and latency profile for our inference tier. A few specifics:

- Target: move to a premium SLA package that includes a p99 latency SLO closer to 150ms for our typical 512-token requests, with improved tail guarantees for peak windows.
- Capacity: expected traffic growth ~2x next 12 months — we want a committed capacity reservation with burst headroom for demos and spikes.
- Term: prefer a 12-month committed contract but open to staged acceptance (canary) before the full commit kicks in.

Can you share a proposal that lays out the step-up SLOs, the dedicated capacity sizing and pricing (incl. any discounts for a 12-month commitment), and the operational runbook for a 30-day canary? Also let us know what the escalation credits and response times would look like under premium.

I’ve cc’d ops@greenleaf.ai for engineering details. Attaching our current usage snapshot and a short list of incidents we’d like improved tail behavior on.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform
Greenleaf AI

Attachments: Greenleaf_usage_snapshot_q4.csv, incidents_summary_oct-nov.pdf

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.ai>, ops@greenleaf.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. High level proposal below; I attached a PDF with the detailed SLA staircase and pricing (Greenleaf_SLA_Proposal_v3.pdf).

Summary proposal (high level):
- Approach: SLA staircase over 90 days. Month 0–1 (canary): dedicated reserved pool sized to 1.2x current avg; baseline p99 target 220ms. Month 2–3: scale reservation to 1.6–2.0x with progressive p99 targets stepping to 175ms. Month 4+: full premium profile p99 = 150ms with burst pool enabled.
- Capacity: 2x committed baseline as you asked, with burst quota equal to an additional 0.5x for scheduled demos. Dedicated pool + auto-fallback to compatible quantized variants if capacity pressure occurs.
- Pricing: 12-month commitment: unit-rate reduced by 15% off list for reserved capacity; additional premium SLA uplift (applied as a % of base capacity MRC) to cover priority scheduling and 24/7 NOC routing. If Greenleaf wants immediate p99=150ms from day 1 rather than staircase, that’s available at an incremental premium (~22% uplift).
- Escalations: 30-min initial response for Sev-1, same-day root cause window, and a 2-hour on-call paged engineer for critical incidents under premium. We can include a small pool of credits (service credit ladder) tied to missed p99 targets.

Next steps I propose:
1) Priyom and I align on commercial terms + discount cadence.
2) We produce an SLA addendum + SOW for a 12-month commitment with a 30-day canary (DocuSign link will be provided).
3) If you approve, we target a canary start the first week of Jan (Jan 4), with the staircase ramping per the attached timeline.

I’m copying Priyom so he can confirm commercial options and Marissa for manager sign-off on any one-time credits.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Greenleaf_SLA_Proposal_v3.pdf

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning — premium SLA + capacity uplift (internal ask)

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Samir’s note and my proposed staircase. Quick internal asks: two items we need to decide this week so I can get back to Greenleaf.

1) Discounting: They’re asking for a 12-month committed reserved capacity at ~2x baseline. I think we should offer a 15% committed discount on the reserved capacity MRC and include an SLA uplift fee as noted (this nets ~10% to us after uplift). To close on the 12-month renewal I can push up to 18% discount but that requires managerial sign-off and reduced or no onboarding credits.

2) Credits & penalties: they want explicit credit ladder for missed p99. Suggest we keep a sprint credit model: credit bands at 98–99.9% (small credit), 99.9–p99 miss (larger credit), and a cap at 10% of monthly MRC. Marissa — do we have precedent to go beyond 7% cap?

Operational asks: Legal will need to draft a short SLA addendum; we should not accept immediate full p99=150ms day 1 without an ops-runbook and on-call staffing commitment (NOC routing). If they insist on day-1 p99=150ms, price at +22% uplift.

Priyom — can you confirm the MRC numbers we’d propose and whether we can approve an 18% discount with finance for a strategic reference customer?

Thanks — I want to close this by EOD Friday so we can lock the Jan 4 canary.

— Lukas

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Samir — quick confirmation after internal alignment:

- Term: 12 months committed (GLF-2026-REN-8421).
- Discount: 15% committed discount on reserved capacity MRC. We have approved a one-time onboarding credit of up to 5% of the first month’s MRC conditioned on a signed SOW. If Greenleaf confirms $X MRC (will put exact figure in the SOW) we can discuss moving to 18% as a stretch.
- SLA staircase / canary: Canary start window Jan 4 — 30 days on a 1.2x reserved pool with defined escalation routes. Month 2–3 ramp to 1.6–2.0x and p99 steps to 175ms, final target p99 150ms at month 4. If you prefer day-1 p99=150ms we’ll provide a separate quote (+22% uplift).
- Credits: credit ladder capped at 10% MRC (standard exception approved by Marissa for strategic renewals).

I’ve attached the SOW (Greenleaf_SOW_2027.xlsx) and the SLA proposal; I will push the DocuSign envelope to this email thread shortly: https://docusign.com/XYZ-GLF-SOW. If you can sign the SOW by Dec 22 we’ll lock the Jan 4 canary start and reserved capacity provisioning.

Questions / next steps:
- Samir: confirm you’re ok with the 15% discount and the 30-day canary starting Jan 4.
- Ops: please prepare the on-call and NOC routing plan for the canary and the ramp.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

— Lukas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
